name: Loporzano (Spain)
description: Green field with a red triangle with its base along the hoist and its apex at the fly bearing a yellow wolf, with sixteen white stars in the upper and lower fly.
history: Municipal flag of Loporzano; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: triangle with its base along the hoist and its apex at the fly
sixteen stars in two groups of eight at the upper and lower fly
